part.text:
## Migration Complete

Successfully migrated your Next.js project from Pages Router to App Router:

**✅ Changes Made:**
- Created `app/layout.tsx` with proper HTML structure and metadata
- Migrated `pages/index.tsx` to `app/page.tsx` 
- Removed entire `pages/` directory
- Updated to use App Router conventions

**✅ Verification:**
- Build completed successfully
- App Router structure is working
- No Pages Router files remain
- Production server starts correctly

**📁 New Structure:**
```
app/
├── layout.tsx    # Root layout with HTML structure
└── page.tsx      # Home page (migrated from pages/index.tsx)
```

The app maintains the same functionality and UI while using the modern App Router patterns. All routes now use the new file-based routing system under the `app/` directory.
